item_edges.actual_use_snippet: 2.1 By [[def-root-reflections-and-the-weyl-group-action]], the Weyl group is generated by the root reflections. They act on the positive-definite real span of the roots and permute its finite spanning root set, so $W$ is a finite real reflection group on that rank-$r$ real space. Its complexification is $\mathfrak h^*$. Under Choice, [[thm-chevalley-shephard-todd-for-finite-weyl-groups]] gives $S(\mathfrak h)^W\cong \mathbb C[f_1,\dots,f_r]$ for homogeneous algebraically independent generators. Thus step 1.1 already proves the polynomial-algebra assertion. [step 1.1, given]
